text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE on-call @Tina — elevated 5xx rate observed on edge LB affecting /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. Start time ~2024-06-27T17:12Z. Severity: P1. Please ack and triage.

Tina: acked, I'm on it. pulling up dashboards and recent LB configs.

Sam: adding context — spike started ~17:12 UTC, 5xx rate jumped to ~6.4% from baseline 0.7%. Errors mainly 503/504 (upstream reset/timeouts) from envoy frontdoors in us-west-2. No surge in total RPS.

Maya: CS report: multiple customers seeing "gateway error" in product telemetry, a couple high-visibility accounts impacted. I'm drafting outreach.

Olga: I see a config rollout for edge-lb completed at 17:05 — changed route weighting and deployed a new retry policy (increase attempts to 2, enabled retry_on:5xx).

Ryan: that matches a known amplification pattern — retries at proxy + upstream transient failures -> heavier load -> more failures. recommend disabling retries at the proxy immediately and revert route weighting shuffle.

Tina: agreed. plan: 1) disable proxy retries (edge) 2) revert route weights to previous stable config 3) recycle frontdoor pods if errors persist. Will perform in that order.

Tina: running patch to set retry policy to none on envoy config service now:
```bash
kubectl patch configmap edge-envoy-retry -n infra --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/retry_policy","value":"none"}]'
```

DeployBot: configmap patch applied to edge clusters (us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-west-1). rollout started.

Sam: pulling logs — upstreams returning connection reset_by_peer and 504s. Circuit-breaker hits spiked at the same time as retry increase.

Olga: initiating rollback of route weight rollout to last-known-good (weight map v2024-06-27-16:50). Applying now.

Tina: rolling pods on frontdoor (deployment/frontdoor-edge) with graceful drain to avoid in-flight token loss. Rolling restart started (3 pods).

Ryan: useful quick check: disable retries + revert weights should reduce request amplification immediately. Also consider increasing per-host circuit breaker max connections temporarily to avoid tripping on short spikes. But doing that is higher-risk, prefer throttling retries first.

Sam: metrics update — 2 minutes after retry disable: 5xx dropped from 6.4% -> 2.1%. Good sign.

Tina: frontdoor pods 3/3 restarted. performing health checks.

Maya: CS update: sending this message template to impacted customers (will post copy here):
"Hi — we're investigating elevated gateway errors affecting the API since 17:12 UTC. We've applied mitigation and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and timing. — Maya, CS"

CS-Bot: Noted top 12 impacted accounts (IDs redacted) — outreach queued.

Sam: tail latencies improving: p95 for /v1/generate down from 1.9s -> 1.15s; error rate trending to ~0.9% now.

Olga: I've opened a follow-up ticket to revert the retry_policy change in the deployment pipeline and require a canary test for any retry policy changes. Ticket: PLT-4821.

Ryan: recommended post-mortem action items: 1) add preflight check to CI that simulates a small failure and measures amplification with retries 2) add alert to detect simultaneous increase in retry attempts + 5xx 3) document safe-cfg for circuit-breakers.

Tina: Incident status: mitigated enough to reduce customer impact. Downgrading severity to P2. On-call handoff: staying on for 30m monitoring, then handing to @Ryan for RCA and follow-up actions.

DeployBot: rollback of route-weight rollout completed. retry policy left disabled on edge for now.

Sam: final metrics snapshot at 17:36 UTC: 5xx = 0.85% (close to baseline), error responses mostly residual upstream timeouts. No traffic drop.

Maya: CS: outreach sent to impacted accounts, offering post-incident summary.

Olga: will run config audit and create a gating rule for retry policy changes (can't be >0 attempts without staging canary).

Tina: adding quick notes for incident timeline and handoff. I'll attach logs and dashboard links in the follow-up ticket.

IncidentBot: Incident downgraded to P2 at 2024-06-27T17:36Z. Handing to Ryan for RCA/next steps. If metrics climb again, re-escalate. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: taking ownership for RCA and action items. Thanks team — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:

Tina: thanks all, monitoring for 30m then sign off. (added :eyes:)
